info.title: Groundwork Query Runtime API
info.description:
Zero-Trust AI Context Firewall for agentic AI. Groundwork sits between AI applications and private data sources, enforcing live permissions, data residency, and audit requirements on every query _before_ any data reaches a model.

The public surface documented here covers:

- **`POST /v1/query`** - permission-checked, firewall-redacted retrieval with per-chunk provenance (watermarks) and an immutable trace.
- **`GET /v1/leak-report`** - connector-backed scan of external indexes for documents that should have been restricted.
- **`POST /v1/security/break-glass/grants`** and **`.../{id}/revoke`** - time-bounded, reason-mandatory emergency admin access that mints a short-lived admin-scoped API key. Every lifecycle transition is hash-chained evidence.
- **`GET /v1/audit/verify`** - recompute the tenant's append-only hash chain and prove that no historical row was altered or deleted.
- **`GET /v1/usage`** - metered consumption per metric against the tenant's configured limits.

## Authentication

Every endpoint requires an API key sent as `X-Groundwork-API-Key`. Keys are scoped; an endpoint is callable only by a key that carries its required scope (`query`, `audit`, `usage`, `break_glass`, and `admin`, which satisfies any scope). All paths additionally accept `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

Request bodies never carry tenant/region/identity: the tenant is resolved from the API key and identity from signed headers. A key that fails resolution or has expired returns `401`; a key without the endpoint's scope returns `403 insufficient_scope`.

## Fail-closed behavior

If the authorizer, vector backend, or engine is unavailable, `POST /v1/query` returns **zero chunks** (or a 5xx) and writes a `FAIL_CLOSED` decision to the immutable audit log. There is no fallback to an open state.

post.summary: Run a permission-checked, firewall-filtered query for a verified user
post.description:
Retrieves candidate chunks from the vector/keyword backends, evaluates **every chunk against live permissions** (SpiceDB in production), applies the zero-trust context firewall (PII redaction, indirect prompt-injection blocking, provenance watermarking), and returns an answer with citations and an immutable audit trace.

- Requires an API key with scope `query`.
- Requires `user_id` in the body and a verified identity: either an `X-Groundwork-User-Assertion` JWT (HMAC or OIDC) or an `X-Groundwork-Delegation-Token` minted for an agent run (with matching `run_id`). Without identity the request fails closed.
- Fail-closed: authorizer/backend/engine unavailability returns zero chunks and records `FAIL_CLOSED` in the audit log.
- Idempotency: the server stamps `X-Groundwork-Correlation-Id` on the audit row; pass it to make the trace id deterministic.

parameters.name: X-Groundwork-Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Client-supplied correlation id; stamped onto the audit row so the client-visible trace id matches the server record.

parameters.name: X-Groundwork-User-Assertion
parameters.description: Signed identity assertion (JWT, HS256 HMAC or OIDC) binding the caller to `user_id`. Verified before any retrieval; invalid or missing identity fails closed.

parameters.name: X-Groundwork-Delegation-Token
parameters.description: Agent delegation token for run-scoped queries. When present, `run_id` must match the run the token was minted for.

200.description: Answer with permission-checked citations and an immutable audit trace.

401.description: API key missing (`missing_api_key`), invalid (`invalid_api_key`), expired (`api_key_expired`), or identity assertion invalid (`invalid_identity_assertion`, `identity_verifier_unavailable`).

403.description: Key lacks scope `query` (`insufficient_scope`) or the user identity could not be resolved (`identity_unresolved`).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (`rate_limit_exceeded`); retry after backoff.

get.summary: Scan connected external indexes for missing-scope documents
get.description:
Read-only compliance scan (e.g. over the connected GitHub org's indexed repos) that reports documents which should have been restricted - files pushed before an org was onboarded, excluded paths that got indexed, or permissions that were tightened after indexing.

- Requires an API key with scope `audit`.
- Returns `503 connector_unavailable` when no connector service is wired.

401.description: API key missing, invalid, or expired.

post.summary: Open a time-bounded emergency admin grant
post.description:
Opens an active break-glass grant that mints a short-lived, admin-scoped API key, and appends hash-chained `opened` evidence to the tenant's write-once event chain. The raw minted key is returned **once** in this response and never persisted - an operator who loses it must open a new grant.

- Requires an API key with scope `break_glass` **and** a verified operator identity (`X-Groundwork-User-Assertion` JWT).
- `reason` is mandatory; `duration_minutes` is capped by `BREAK_GLASS_MAX_MINUTES` (default 60, min 1).

parameters.name: X-Groundwork-User-Assertion
parameters.description: Verified operator identity assertion (JWT). The operator principal is bound to the grant and every lifecycle event.

201.description: Grant opened; `key` is the one-time, short-lived admin API key.

400.description: Malformed body (`invalid_json`), missing reason (`reason_required`), or invalid duration (`break_glass_open_failed`).

401.description: No tenant context (`missing_tenant_context`) or API key invalid/expired.

403.description: Key lacks scope `break_glass` (`insufficient_scope`) or no verified operator identity (`verified_identity_required`).

post.description:
Terminates an active grant early - immediately revoking its minted API key - and appends hash-chained `revoked` evidence with the mandatory reason.

- Requires an API key with scope `break_glass` and a verified operator identity.
- Grants past `expires_at` are lazily flipped to `expired`; revoking an inactive grant returns `409 break_glass_grant_not_active`.

parameters.name: X-Groundwork-User-Assertion
parameters.description: Verified operator identity assertion (JWT); recorded as the revocation actor.

400.description: Malformed body (`invalid_json`), missing grant id (`grant_id_required`), or missing reason (`reason_required`).

401.description: No tenant context (`missing_tenant_context`) or API key invalid/expired.

403.description: Key lacks scope `break_glass` (`insufficient_scope`) or no verified operator identity (`verified_identity_required`).

404.description: No grant with this id for the tenant (`break_glass_grant_not_found`).

409.description: Grant exists but is no longer active (`break_glass_grant_not_active`).

get.summary: Verify the tenant's immutable audit hash chain
get.description:
Recomputes the append-only SHA-256 hash chain for the calling tenant's audit log. Every row digests its predecessor (ordered by the immutable `seq` identity to stay stable under concurrent writes), so a rewritten, deleted, or reordered row fails verification with a per-row problem entry.

- Requires an API key with scope `audit`.
- Refuses chains above the server maximum with `413` and `error chain_too_large` - a signal to archive before re-verifying. (Not: an over-large chain is never walked, so downtime is bounded.)
- Returns `503 audit_unavailable` when no read-side audit store is wired.

200.description: Chain verification result; `problems` is empty when every entry is intact.

401.description: API key missing, invalid, or expired.

413.description: Chain exceeds the server's verify limit (`chain_too_large`); archive before re-verifying.

get.summary: Snapshot metered usage for the calling tenant
get.description:
Returns current counts per metric against configured limits for the current month. `remaining` is `-1` when a metric is unlimited; when a limited metric would be exceeded, the governing endpoint fails closed before performing the work.

- Requires an API key with scope `usage`.

200.description: Usage snapshot for the calling tenant.

401.description: API key missing, invalid, or expired.

apiKey.name: X-Groundwork-API-Key
apiKey.description: Tenant API key. Scoped; `admin` satisfies any scope. Also accepted as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

identityAssertion.name: X-Groundwork-User-Assertion
identityAssertion.description: Verified end-user identity assertion (JWT, signed via the configured HMAC secret or OIDC issuer). Required by endpoints that must attribute actions to a human operator.

Error.description: Error envelope: a stable machine-readable `error` code.

QueryRequest.description: Zero-trust query. Identity comes from the signed header, never the body.

user_id.description: End-user principal id; must match the verified identity assertion. ACLs are evaluated against this principal at query time - no caching.

question.description: Natural-language query. Scanned by the context firewall for indirect prompt injection before retrieval.
question.example: What shipped in the last sprint?

source_scopes.description: Optional filter of per-document required scopes to restrict retrieval to.

idk_threshold.description: Below this confidence, the engine answers 'I don't know' instead of guessing. Server default applies when omitted.

run_id.description: Agent run id; required and verified when authenticating with an `X-Groundwork-Delegation-Token`.

answer.description: Generated answer grounded in the permitted chunks (or an I-Don't-Know response).

citations.description: Permission-checked chunks that grounded the answer, ranked by score.

chunk_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the chunk text - the per-chunk provenance fingerprint an auditor can re-derive.

text.description: Chunk text, post-firewall: PII redacted, prompt-injection spans removed in block mode.

watermark.description: Context-firewall provenance signature over (tenant, chunk id, text), HMAC'd with the firewall key. Verify with firewall.VerifyWatermark; empty when no firewall key is set.

RuntimeTrace.description: Immutable evidence record of one query decision, mirrored verbatim into the audit log.

trace_id.description: Correlation id; matches X-Groundwork-Correlation-Id when supplied.

blocked_by_acl.description: Chunks removed by the live permission check (SpiceDB in production).

decision_mode.description: enforce: ACL blocked chunks are dropped. shadow: they are counted but delivered (shadow deployment). fail_closed: backend failure - zero chunks.

shadow_mode.description: True when in shadow (would-block) mode for ACL decisions.

failure_stage.description: Where a fail-closed path stopped (e.g. authorizer_backend, engine).

access_decisions.description: Per-chunk allow/deny verdicts with reasons - the audit granularity for every candidate.

immutable_digest.description: SHA-256 over the trace record; rooted into the append-only audit hash chain.

firewall_redactions.description: PII spans redacted by the zero-trust context firewall.

firewall_blocked_chunks.description: Chunks excluded from context in block mode.

firewall_watermarked.description: Chunks signed with a provenance watermark.

policy_l2_fallbacks.description: Decisions escalated to the backend policy store.

reason.example: principal:bob has no access to scope engineering

findings.description: Documents that should have been restricted but are reachable in an indexed external system.

reason.description: Mandatory accountable rationale; recorded as hash-chained evidence.
reason.example: Prod incident - on-call operator needs temporary admin

duration_minutes.description: Time-to-live for the minted admin key. Capped by BREAK_GLASS_MAX_MINUTES (default 60).

BreakGlassOpenResponse.description: 201 response. `key` is one-time and never persisted - record it securely.

key.description: Short-lived admin-scoped API key (raw). Shown once; expires with the grant.

operator_principal_id.description: Verified operator who opened the grant.

key_id.description: Stable id of the minted API key.

immutable_digest.description: Tamper-evident digest over every binding field.

verified.description: True when every entry's digest chain is intact.

problems.description: Per-entry integrity issues, e.g. broken_link (previous_hash mismatch) or digest_mismatch (row fields rewritten). Present only when the chain is damaged.

ChainTooLargeResponse.description: 413 response from GET /v1/audit/verify when the chain exceeds the server cap.

max_allowed.description: Server's verification cap; archive before re-verifying.

usage.description: One row per metered metric/period combination.

metric.description: Metered metric: agents, runs, decisions, connector_calls, exports, storage_bytes.
